TechNova Solutions Pvt. Ltd. - Leave Policy
2. Casual Leave
Employees are allowed 12 casual leaves per year. Casual leave is intended to
accommodate unforeseen circumstances, personal emergencies, or brief personal
matters that require an employee's attention during standard working hours.
Casual leave is credited at the beginning of each calendar year. For employees
joining mid-year, casual leave is pro-rated based on the date of joining. Casual leave
cannot be carried forward to the next calendar year and cannot be encashed.

TechNova Solutions Pvt. Ltd. - Leave Policy
3. Sick Leave
TechNova recognizes that employees may occasionally fall ill and require time off to
recover. Employees are granted 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year.
Sick leave can be taken for personal illness, medical appointments, or to care for an
immediate family member who is unwell. A valid medical certificate from a registered
medical practitioner is required for sick leave extending beyond 3 consecutive working
days. Sick leave cannot be encashed but can be carried forward up to a maximum of
20 days.
